clips.title: The story
paras: Melor Stonehoof is a veteran tauren huntsman stationed atop Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. As a mentor in the ways of the hunt, he tests the tracking prowess and mettle of Horde hunters by sending them after the most dangerous predatory beasts across the Barrens and Thousand Needles.

Perched upon the breezy expanse of Hunter Rise, Melor Stonehoof observes the plains below with a practiced eye. The art of the hunt is sacred to the tauren, entwined with survival, spiritual balance, and respect for nature's greatest predators. Melor ensures that those who carry bow and blade in the name of the Horde understand this balance, directing promising stalkers to master their craft through trials against legendary beasts.

Melor challenges hunters to seek out legendary and elusive beasts that terrorize the wild. He directs trackers across the plains of the Barrens, from aiding the huntress Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads to pursuing Steelsnap, a cunning and vicious hyena in Thousand Needles. Through these trials, hunters prove they can outsmart and outfight the deadliest creatures of central Kalimdor.

For those whose skills exceed the Barrens, Melor points toward far-off lands. He charges seasoned hunters with bringing down beasts of terrifying strength, including Deadmire, an ancient crocolisk lurking in the swamps of Dustwallow Marsh, and the savage yeti Frostmaw of the Alterac Mountains. Each hunt serves to test whether a stalker has truly mastered the Hunter's Way.
